name: Blue NAP Americas Datacenter CU-1
notes: Willemstad/Kaya Seru di Mahuma carrier-neutral Tier IV facility. Official site states it is the only Uptime Certified Tier IV and ANSI-TIA-942-B Rated 4 certified datacenter in the Caribbean; Uptime lists Dataplanet N.V. Blue NAP Americas Datacenter CU-1 in Willemstad. Baxtel reports year built 2017, 55,000 sq ft building, 10,000 sq ft whitespace, dual independent 5 MW power plants and 5 MW market figure. AMS-IX says the facility launched in December 2016 and became an AMS-IX Caribbean POP in 2019. Former/related CTEX CU-1 project at same Seru Mahuma area appears to be the predecessor rather than a separate current facility.

name: E-Commerce Park N.V. Data Center
notes: Willemstad/E-Zone Vredenberg colocation data center. DataCenterMap lists suites, cages, cabinets, individual servers and an operational 2008 expansion of 10,000 sq ft for business continuity/disaster recovery. Baxtel says first phase construction began winter 2000 with a purpose-built data center capacity of 110 cabinets, plus a 29,000 sq ft office campus, and categorizes the facility as Tier III/N+1. AMS-IX says E-Commerce Park has hosted AMS-IX Caribbean presence since 2008. PRNewswire/SRI described it as in operation since November 2001 and a built-for-purpose Caribbean data center.

name: CORE N.V. Datacenter
notes: Willemstad CORE N.V. datacenter. CORE official home page states it operates an ANSI/TIA-942-C-2024 Rated 3 Certified Datacenter located on Curaçao; CORE vacancy page describes a growing ANSI/TIA 942-C Rated 3 certified datacenter offering private cloud, co-location, business continuity, network/server management and consulting. EPI certification map lists CORE N.V. at Vesuviusstraat 18, Willemstad, Curacao with ANSI/TIA-942-C Facility Rated 3 certification expiring 2027-05-09. DataCenterMap lists the CORE Datacenter at 18 Vesuviusstraat.
